questions.passage:
A university has drawn up a workable plan to share teaching rooms between departments. The rooms are suitable and the scheduling software has been tested. Approval has nevertheless stalled. Several departments want to retain their customary rooms, while a commercial conference organiser fears losing access during the holidays. Both have pressed the governing committee to leave the arrangements unchanged.

Calling this a failure of the scheduling staff misses the source of the delay. The staff have shown that a different timetable is possible. What they cannot decide is whose claims the committee should give up protecting. The difficulty lies in competing interests being defended through the approval process.
questions.q: The delay in approving the plan results mainly from
o: the staff's inability to operate the scheduling software.
pressure from groups defending existing arrangements.
a shortage of rooms suitable for ordinary teaching.
the organiser's failure to attract holiday conferences.
questions.target: 区分主动施压与能力不足，并保留多个主体
questions.skill: 区分主动施压与能力不足，并保留多个主体
questions.answer_support: The difficulty lies in competing interests being defended through the approval process.

exp.trans: 方案技术可行，但院系和商业会议方都为保留现有权益施压审批委员会。
exp.structure: 可行性事实排除技术无能，再定位实际阻碍是多方利益要求。
exp.other: press：施压；governing committee：管理委员会。
exp.meaning: pressure对应利益干预，不是工作人员不会操作。正确项也保留了不止一个群体的范围。
exp.rest: 软件已经测试，教室也适用；文中未说会议方招不到客户。

questions.q:
Calling the volunteers' six-month restoration project “not entirely useless” struck the team as faint praise.
哪句改写最准确？
o: The team heard an enthusiastic celebration of the project.
The comment offered only a very weak form of approval.
The comment proved that the project had failed completely.
The team was told that the project had won an award.

exp.trans: 把志愿者历时六个月的修复项目说成“并非完全没有用”，让团队觉得这只是很勉强的赞扬。
exp.structure: Calling the volunteers' six-month restoration project ‘not entirely useless’是整个动名词短语主语；struck是谓语；the team是宾语；as faint praise表示给团队留下何种印象。短语内部call A B：称A为B。
exp.other: restoration 修复；entirely 完全；strike sb as sth 给某人以某种印象；approval 赞许。
exp.meaning: faint praise并非赞扬完全不存在，而是肯定得很有限，甚至暗含保留意见。
exp.rest: enthusiastic celebration表示热情赞颂，力度过强；had failed completely表示彻底失败，把微弱肯定改成全面否定；had won an award表示获奖，原文没有提供获奖事实。

questions.skill: 从目标、动机和相互作用判断词义
questions.passage: A company that delivers groceries wants suppliers to use standard crate sizes so that workers can stack the crates more quickly. A recycling cooperative supports the proposal because uniform crates are easier to collect and reuse. The two groups disagree about who should pay to replace the old crates. The cooperative would rather wait until crates wear out before replacing them, while the delivery company wants a faster change. Even so, their interests are aligned on the proposed standard.
questions.q: What does "aligned" imply about the two groups' interests?
o: They favour the same outcome on crate sizes.
They prefer the same schedule for replacing crates.
Their competing aims cancel each other out.
They have identical reasons for backing the plan.
questions.answer_support: A recycling cooperative supports the proposal because uniform crates are easier to collect and reuse.

exp.trans: 一家食品配送企业支持使用统一规格的周转箱，方便堆放。一家回收合作社也支持，理由是方便回收和再用。两方对谁付更换费用、换得多快各有想法，但都希望有统一规格。
exp.structure: 开头两句交代同一个提议以及各自支持的理由。Even so 从分歧转回双方在哪个具体问题上有共识，on the proposed standard 限定共识的范围。
exp.other: crate（周转箱）、stack（堆放）、cooperative（合作社）、wear out（用坏、磨损）。
exp.meaning: aligned 在此指利益方向吻合。identical reasons 会要求两方的理由完全一样。counterbalance 讲相反的效果相互抵消，例如额外的维修费抵消了节省下来的费用。complement 则强调各自补上另一方欠缺的功能。
exp.rest: 材料明说双方更换节奏不同。两者支持相同规格，作用方向一致，各自希望实现的堆放效率与回收便利也有区别。

questions.skill: 区分认可一项做法与相信其所有承诺
questions.passage:
For years, people who reported damaged footpath signs to the county rarely heard back. The county now keeps a public register of the reports and names the maintenance team responsible for each sign. It also promises to repair every sign within a month, a pledge that will be hard to keep on paths where workers have to carry equipment for miles.

While the register leaves many repair dates unspecified, it already lets people see whether their reports have reached the right team. That makes it worth keeping even if the county has to give up its one-month deadline.
questions.q: How does the author view the public register?
o: It has practical value despite missing information.
It shows that the promised deadline will be met.
It has little value until it gives firm repair dates.
It makes reports from remote paths less useful.
questions.answer_support: That makes it worth keeping even if the county has to give up its one-month deadline.

exp.trans: 以往报修步道标志的人很少收到回复。郡政府开始公开登记各项报告和负责的维修小组，也承诺一个月内修好。偏远路段很难兑现时限，登记表也有很多日期没写，但人们已经能看到自己的报告是否到了负责的小组。即使放弃一个月的时限，公开登记仍值得保留。
exp.structure: While 从句承认许多修复日期没有说明。逗号后的主句交代登记表已经提供的价值，最后一句直接评价它值得保留。
exp.other: footpath（步道）、register（登记表）、pledge（承诺）、unspecified（未具体说明的）。
exp.meaning: 作者对公开登记给予有限肯定，对维修时限有保留。affirmation 表示认可，skepticism 表示有所怀疑，判断前要看清题干问的是登记表还是时限。
exp.rest: 文章质疑一月时限能否兑现。只看到日期不明确，会漏掉读者能追踪报告的价值。偏远给维修造成困难，文章没有贬低这些路段的报修记录。

questions.target: with 加名词和未完成的状态
questions.skill: 分清主句动作与插入内容所示的状态
questions.q:
The museum, with two loan agreements still unsigned, postponed publication of its exhibition catalogue.

What was still outstanding when publication was postponed?
o: The catalogue needed photographs of two objects.
The museum had yet to arrange transport for the loans.
The date of the exhibition still had to be announced.
Two agreements still needed to be signed.

exp.trans: 还有两份借展协议没签，馆方推迟出版展览图录。
exp.structure: 主句是 The museum postponed publication。with 后的主项是 two loan agreements，still unsigned 描述它们当时尚未签署的状态。
exp.other: loan agreement（借展协议）、postpone（推迟）、catalogue（图录）、outstanding（尚未处理完的）。
exp.meaning: 两份文件尚待签署。unsigned 陈述完成状态，句中没有指明是哪一方尚未签字。
exp.rest: 书面协议和运输、照片、展览日期是不同事项。原文只点明尚未处理完的协议。

questions.skill: 区分主题上的先例与现实问题的成因
questions.passage:
Old ledgers from a furniture workshop differ sharply in what they tell us. In the monthly accounts, the owner cited sales as evidence that the chairs were popular. In a notebook kept on the shop floor, workers wrote down which customers came back with loose joints and broken legs. In some of the best months for sales, that notebook also showed an unusual number of repairs.

The gap between the two records foreshadowed a problem that is familiar to anyone who evaluates online courses. Many providers publish the fraction of students who reach a course's final page. That figure tells us how many have clicked through the material. It leaves open whether they can use any of it afterwards without assistance.
questions.q: The author refers to the furniture workshop mainly to
o: explain how the repair process affected chair sales.
trace how online courses adopted their current measures.
illustrate what a common measure of success leaves out.
show how customer complaints can improve a product.
questions.answer_support: That figure tells us how many have clicked through the material. It leaves open whether they can use any of it afterwards without assistance.

exp.trans: 旧家具作坊的账册记录销量，工人另记有哪些椅子需要返修。有些销量最好的月份也出现了较多返修。两份记录的落差预示了网课评估中的类似问题。点到最后一页的人数告诉我们多少人浏览完了材料，至于他们之后能否独立应用，仍需查证。
exp.structure: 第一段摆出销售记录和维修记录，第二段用同一个问题连起网课统计。销量和翻到最后一页都是可计数的结果。两段分别补出这个数字没有反映的一面。
exp.other: ledger（账簿）、joint（接合处）、fraction（比例）、leave open（让问题仍未有定论）。
exp.meaning: foreshadow 指先显现后来还会遇到的问题。spark 指触发后续事情。作坊的记录让我们看到单个数字遗漏什么，这个道理在评估网课时仍适用。
exp.rest: 销量与返修同时出现，文中未交代返修怎样影响销量。作坊记录与网课统计是类比，没有交代后者的历史来源。作者也未讨论家具工艺如何改进。

questions.target: 插入的让步小句与限定范围
questions.skill: 识别承诺覆盖的条件及主句结果
questions.q:
The festival, although it has lost its main sponsor, will fund whatever performances can take place outdoors using existing equipment.

Which performances will the festival fund?
o: Outdoor shows that can use the equipment already available.
Indoor shows that can go ahead without the main sponsor.
Outdoor shows for which it can afford to buy new equipment.
Shows using equipment that the former sponsor promised to buy.

exp.trans: 尽管失去了主要赞助商，节庆仍会资助那些能用现有设备在室外演出的节目。
exp.structure: 先跳过 although 小句接起 The festival → will fund whatever performances...。整个 whatever 结构是受资助的对象。结构内部 performances 是 can take place 的主语。
exp.other: festival（节庆）、sponsor（赞助商）、fund（资助）、existing（现有的）。
exp.meaning: 受资助的演出要同时满足室外举行和用现有设备。although 交代让步背景，资助范围要到主句里找。
exp.rest: 室内节目缺少一个条件，另买设备缺少另一个条件。赞助商承诺购置什么设备没有交代。

questions.target: 跨句识别负责执行的主体
questions.skill: 跨句识别负责执行的主体
questions.q: A council built a website where residents could ask outside contractors to stop marketing messages. The contractors promised to comply. Who is responsible for changing the outgoing messages?
o: The outside contractors.
The residents who used the form.
The council members who created the site.
The unrelated firms hosting the city's internet connection.

exp.trans: 市议会提供请求渠道，居民提出停止消息的要求，但真正承诺停止发送营销信息的是外部承包商。
exp.structure: 第一句council built引出平台建设者；第二句The contractors promised to comply明确承诺者和履行请求的执行方。
exp.other: council市议会；contractor承包商；comply遵守；marketing message营销信息。
exp.meaning: 指代分析不能只看上文最近被提到的组织，还要核对承诺、执行和发送行为对应的真实主语。
exp.rest: 居民是请求方，市议会是平台建设方；互联网连接服务商没有参与这项承诺，也没有文本证据表明它能停止消息。

interference-capacity.passage:
An audit of a scholarship office found the same calculation error in dozens of applications. The staff had misunderstood a simple scoring rule and had received no training before using it. There was no evidence that applicants had pressured the office to change their marks. The review described the failures as incompetence rather than favouritism.

That distinction matters for the response. A clearer rule and supervised training could address the problem identified by the audit. Investigating influence from outside groups would answer a different question. An institution can make serious mistakes because its staff cannot perform a task properly, even when nobody is trying to interfere with their decisions.
interference-capacity.q: The word "incompetence" in Paragraph 1 most nearly means
o: deliberate pressure from outsiders.
unfair preference for certain applicants.
lack of ability to perform a task properly.
refusal to disclose a successful procedure.
interference-capacity.target: 在确有能力不足证据时正确识别incompetence
interference-capacity.skill: 在确有能力不足证据时正确识别incompetence
interference-capacity.answer_support: its staff cannot perform a task properly

exp.trans: 审计发现工作人员误解计算规则且未受培训，没有外部施压证据，因此判断为能力不足而非偏袒。
exp.structure: 先给事实并区分原因，第二段说明不同原因需要不同的应对。
exp.other: incompetence：不能胜任；favouritism：偏袒；interfere：干预。
exp.meaning: 正确项对应不能适当完成工作。本题不是教成凡遇制度问题都选利益干预，而是按材料判断。
exp.rest: 外部施压和偏袒均被文中排除；拒绝公开成功做法没有事实支持。

faint.q: After a two-hour presentation, Maya said, “Well, at least the slides were readable.” Her remark is best described as:
o: faint praise
earnest approval
open hostility
sufficient evidence

diag.1: earnest approval 是真诚而明确的赞许；“at least...”只给了很弱的一点肯定。
diag.2: 这句话并非直接敌意攻击，而是非常有限、勉强的表扬。
diag.3: evidence 是“证据”，不是评价语气。

exp.trans: 听完一场两小时的演讲后，Maya 说：“嗯，至少幻灯片还看得清。”这句话最适合形容为“勉强的赞扬”。
exp.structure: Maya（主语）+ said（谓语）+ 引语（内容）。问句 Her remark is best described as... 中 is described是被动谓语，不是is加形容词表语。引语主干为the slides were readable；at least限制了肯定的力度。
exp.other: presentation 演讲/展示；readable 易读的；remark 评论；at least 至少。
exp.meaning: faint praise = 勉强的、力度很弱的赞扬。这里 faint 的核心是“微弱的、不强的”。
exp.rest: earnest approval = 真诚、明确的赞成，语气过强；open hostility = 公开敌意，不符合；sufficient evidence = 充分证据，词义类别都不对。只有 faint praise（力度很弱的赞扬）符合 at least 的保留语气。

faint.q:
After years in the sunlight, only a faint line remained on the old map.
这里 faint 最接近哪种意思？
o: 神圣的
突然出现的
不清晰的
故意伪造的

exp.trans: 经过多年日晒，旧地图上只剩下一条隐约可见的线。
exp.structure: After years in the sunlight是时间背景。only a faint line（主语）+ remained（不及物谓语）；on the old map是地点状语。
exp.other: sunlight 阳光；remain 留下、仍然存在；line 线条；after years 多年之后。
exp.meaning: faint在这里是微弱、不明显的；与faint praise中赞扬力度很弱具有相近的语义核心。
exp.rest: 神圣的常用holy/sacred；圣人是saint，不是faint。突然出现的可说sudden，重点是发生速度，不是清晰度。伪造的可说forged/fake，描述真伪，原句没有这种信息。

author-stance.passage:
A city proposes turning a disused sports ground into a park that can hold floodwater during heavy rain. Residents would gain an open space for most of the year, while nearby streets would face a lower risk of flooding. Some critics object that the park would occasionally have to close just when families wanted to use it.

That inconvenience should be acknowledged. It is not, by itself, a convincing reason to abandon a space that serves two useful purposes. The more important questions concern safe access, reliable maintenance and clear warnings before the water rises. With those arrangements in place, the proposal deserves to move beyond the drawing board.
author-stance.q: The author's attitude towards the proposed park is one of
o: unqualified enthusiasm.
general indifference.
persistent hostility.
conditional approval.
author-stance.target: 判断作者的条件性支持，不把承认缺点读成全面反对
author-stance.skill: 判断作者的条件性支持，不把承认缺点读成全面反对
author-stance.answer_support: With those arrangements in place, the proposal deserves to move beyond the drawing board.

exp.trans: 公园兼具日常开放空间和蓄洪用途，作者承认临时关闭不便，但认为落实安全和维护安排后应推进。
exp.structure: 先列出方案利弊，再明确主要条件，结尾给出有条件的支持。
exp.other: drawing board：设计阶段；maintenance：维护；acknowledge：承认。
exp.meaning: 结尾明确说条件落实后值得推进，因此是conditional approval；既非对所有问题无保留赞美，也非仅仅态度不明。
exp.rest: unqualified抹去了条件；indifference与明确建议推进不符；hostility把承认不便扩大成敌意。

author-stance.passage:
A company selling automated tutoring software predicts that its product will soon make private lessons unnecessary. It points to students who completed practice exercises more quickly after a week of use. The finding may interest teachers looking for ways to provide extra practice. It tells us much less about the company's larger promise.

Speed on a familiar exercise is not the same as understanding a difficult idea. Nor does a week's use show whether students will retain what they have learned. Before accepting a forecast about the disappearance of private lessons, schools need evidence that addresses those questions. The sales pitch has moved rather further than the research behind it.
author-stance.q: The author views the company's prediction with
o: relief.
skepticism.
admiration.
indifference.
author-stance.target: 从证据不足和评价措辞判断怀疑，而非仅凭情绪强弱猜态度
author-stance.skill: 从证据不足和评价措辞判断怀疑，而非仅凭情绪强弱猜态度
author-stance.answer_support: The sales pitch has moved rather further than the research behind it.

exp.trans: 软件提高了短期熟练练习的速度，但公司据此预言私人辅导会消失。作者认为研究不足以支持这一大幅扩展的预测。
exp.structure: 先介绍公司预测及其有限证据，再逐项指出证据与预测之间的缺口。
exp.other: retain：保持、记住；sales pitch：推销说辞；skepticism：怀疑。
exp.meaning: 作者不是单纯说不知道结果，而是指出预测超出了现有研究的支持范围，体现skepticism。
exp.rest: relief和admiration没有评价依据；末句已经明确批评推销承诺走得过远，因此不是indifference。

with.target: with 结构表示与主句同时发生的情形
with.skill: 从插入内容判断动作发生时的状态
with.q:
The conference, with late arrivals still streaming through the doors, began at the announced hour.

What was happening when the conference began?
o: The organisers were announcing a new starting time.
Some people were still coming into the hall.
The main group was leaving for a different hall.
Everyone in the audience had already found a seat.

exp.trans: 还有迟到者陆续进门时，会议已在公布的时间开始。
exp.structure: 主句是 The conference began at the announced hour。逗号间的 with late arrivals still streaming through the doors 写的是当时仍在发生的事。
exp.other: late arrivals（迟到者）、stream（不断涌入）、announced（已公布的）。
exp.meaning: 会议开始时还有人在往里走。streaming 的动作主体是 late arrivals。
exp.rest: 公布时间已经确定，原句没有更改时间。进门的动作也与离开会场或所有人已就座不同。

nested.target: 插入小句与 whatever 结构中的对象
nested.skill: 找出主句实际涉及的事物
nested.q:
The publisher, which has lost several of the original illustrations, will reproduce whatever sketches the artist's family has kept.

Which sketches will the publisher reproduce?
o: Those that the publisher kept from the first edition.
Those that another artist has redrawn for the publisher.
Those that have remained in the artist's family.
Those that were lost after the first edition appeared.

exp.trans: 出版商丢失了几幅原插图，将把艺术家家里保留下来的草图复制出来。
exp.structure: 先接起 The publisher → will reproduce whatever sketches the artist's family has kept。两个逗号间说明出版商的情况。whatever... 是 reproduce 的宾语，has kept 的主语是 the artist's family。
exp.other: illustration（插图）、reproduce（复制）、sketch（草图）、keep（保留）。
exp.meaning: 所选范围是艺术家家里仍保存的任何草图。起作用的限定是家人保存过它们。
exp.rest: 出版商缺失原插图属于背景。原句没有安排他人重画，也没有说它会复制丢失的插图或出版商自己收藏的画稿。

nested.target: 逗号间的转述与主句判断
nested.skill: 插入式转述与句意理解
nested.q:
The drop in morning traffic, transport planners caution, may reflect a shift towards working from home rather than a lasting preference for public transport.

How do the planners interpret the drop in traffic?
o: Commuters may simply be travelling later in the day.
More commuters may be taking the bus instead of driving.
Fewer workers may need to make the usual trip to work.
The fall may be due to a general decline in employment.

exp.trans: 交通规划人员提醒，早晨车流减少，可能是因为越来越多人在家办公，而非人们开始长期偏爱公共交通。
exp.structure: 先跳过两个逗号之间的 transport planners caution，接起 The drop in morning traffic → may reflect a shift towards working from home。逗号中间的小句说明是谁提出这个判断。展开可以读作 Transport planners caution that the drop in morning traffic may reflect a shift towards working from home.
exp.other: reflect（反映）、a shift towards（转向）、lasting preference（持久的偏好）。
exp.meaning: may reflect 表示一种可能的解释。在家办公的人增加，意味着一部分人可能无需像原来那样通勤。
exp.rest: 原句没有提到推迟出发或就业人数下降。公共交通偏好是 rather than 引出的另一种解释，并非规划人员此处提出的原因。

nested.target: 逗号间的补充说明与主句事实
nested.skill: 补充性关系从句与句意理解
nested.q:
The survey of the riverbank, which local officials had hoped would identify a site for new homes, showed only how far floodwater had reached in previous winters.

Which finding did the survey provide?
o: The safest place to build new homes by the river.
The areas affected by flooding in previous winters.
The risk of flooding along the river in the coming winter.
The causes of repeated flooding along the river.

exp.trans: 当地官员原希望这项河岸调查能找出一处建造新住宅的地点，但调查只显示了往年冬季洪水曾漫到哪里。
exp.structure: 主句沿着 The survey of the riverbank → showed only how far floodwater had reached in previous winters 往下读。which 指代 the survey，可把补充说明还原为 Local officials had hoped the survey would identify a site for new homes.
exp.other: riverbank（河岸）、identify a site（确定地点）、floodwater（洪水）。
exp.meaning: 题干问调查实际查明了什么。showed 后面说的是洪水以往漫到的范围。had hoped 交代官员原先的期待。
exp.rest: 住宅选址是预期目标。原句的调查结果关乎过去的洪水范围，没有预测下个冬季的洪水，也没有解释洪水成因。

nested.target: 逗号间的让步小句与主句评价
nested.q:
The extra funding, although it would enable the museum to reopen two galleries, would do little to stop damp from damaging the collection.

What does the sentence suggest about the extra funding?
o: Visitors could see more, but the collection would remain at risk.
Fewer visitors could enter, but the collection would be safer.
The galleries would stay closed until the building could be repaired.
The collection could be protected once the galleries had reopened.

exp.trans: 尽管额外经费能让博物馆重新开放两个展厅，但对于防止潮气损坏藏品，这笔钱起不了多大作用。
exp.structure: 主句是 The extra funding → would do little to stop damp from damaging the collection。两个逗号之间 although 引导让步小句，it 指这笔额外经费。移到句首可读成 Although the funding would enable the museum to reopen two galleries, it would do little to protect the collection from damp.
exp.other: enable sb. to do（使某人能够做某事）、damp（潮气）、collection（藏品）、do little to（对……作用甚微）。
exp.meaning: 展厅重新开放有助于观众参观。主句说这笔钱对防潮作用有限，藏品仍可能受损。
exp.rest: 藏品更安全而参观受限把两层意思颠倒了。原句也没说必须修缮后才开门，或开门后就能保护藏品。

nested.target: 逗号间的条件小句与主句推断
nested.q:
An index of local newspapers, if it is compiled only from copies that happened to survive, can make a town's early press appear less varied than it actually was.

What bias can such an index introduce?
o: It may make early local newspapers seem more widely read.
It may give undue prominence to newspapers that ran only briefly.
It may exaggerate how long individual newspapers lasted.
It may understate the variety of newspapers once published.

exp.trans: 一份地方报纸索引，如果只根据碰巧留存下来的报纸编制，可能会让一个城镇早期的报刊显得没有实际那么多样。
exp.structure: 主句为 An index of local newspapers → can make a town's early press appear less varied than it actually was。逗号中间的 if 小句说明这种偏差发生的条件，it 指索引。小句里的 that happened to survive 修饰 copies，可拆成 Some copies happened to survive.
exp.other: index（索引）、compile（编制）、press（报刊）、understate（把程度说低、低估）。
exp.meaning: 只看留存的报纸，容易遗漏没能保存下来的刊物，所以索引呈现的报刊多样性可能低于当年的情况。
exp.rest: 原句指出的是刊物种类的偏差。它没有说明读者数量，也没有说明短命刊物会被突出或单份刊物的存续时间会被夸大。

nested.target: who 插入定语从句与主句动作
nested.skill: 跳过补充信息找到主句再还原句意
nested.passage: On estates with shared gardens, councils often replace worn benches before the start of summer. Last year one council asked gardeners what else the work might achieve. The gardeners, who already knew which seats received shade, asked that pairs of benches be turned to face each other. Several people said they wanted to sit together without turning at uncomfortable angles to talk. The council had already considered planting more trees, but that remained a separate proposal even after the gardeners gave their advice.
nested.q: What change did the gardeners request?
o: Replacing every bench before the start of summer.
Moving benches away from sunny areas in the garden.
Turning seats towards one another to help people talk.
Planting more trees near the seats that visitors use most.
nested.answer_support: asked that pairs of benches be turned to face each other

exp.trans: 议会常在夏前换掉公共花园的旧长椅。园艺居民知道哪些位子有树荫，提出让长椅两两相对，好坐着聊天而不用费劲扭身。多种树则是另一项提案。
exp.structure: 先将逗号两侧接起来读 The gardeners asked that pairs of benches be turned。who 从句补充他们知道哪些位置有荫，which seats received shade 是 knew 的内容。
exp.other: estate（住宅区）、worn（磨损的）、face each other（相对）、at an angle（成角度）。
exp.meaning: 居民的请求由 asked 引出，重点是椅子朝向和方便交谈。
exp.rest: 换旧椅是议会的常规做法。知道荫凉位置并没有变成要求搬走长椅。种树仍属另一提案。

nested.target: 插入从句里的旧预期与主句发现
nested.skill: 定位说话者当前真正报告的变化
nested.passage: A regional ferry company is testing a way to sell tickets at several shops instead of only at the harbour. The staff at the harbour, who had expected the shops to add to their work, report that the trial has reduced the number of telephone enquiries. Passengers who buy at the shops already have the timetable on their receipts, so harbour staff spend less time repeating it. The company still processes refunds at the harbour and has yet to decide whether to run the scheme through winter.
nested.q: What have harbour staff found during the trial?
o: They receive fewer calls about ferry services.
They have more ticket enquiries to deal with.
The shops now deal with all requests for refunds.
Passengers want the harbour to change its timetable.
nested.answer_support: report that the trial has reduced the number of telephone enquiries

exp.trans: 渡轮公司试让几家店分售船票。港口员工原以为会增加工作，试行后却报告问询电话减少。商店小票上已有时刻表，员工不用一再重复。退款仍在港口办，冬季是否延续还未决定。
exp.structure: 主句接成 The staff at the harbour report that ...。who 从句中的 had expected 说明以前的预期，report 后才是现在验证的结果。
exp.other: trial（试行）、enquiry（问询）、receipt（收据）、refund（退款）。
exp.meaning: 他们现在发现电话咨询减少，原因是小票直接给了时刻表信息。
exp.rest: 工作变多只是之前的预期。退款职能没有改，乘客要求改时刻表也未出现。

dnt-actor-boundary.target: 提出请求、提供设置、执行响应的主体
dnt-actor-boundary.skill: 提出请求、提供设置、执行响应的主体
dnt-actor-boundary.q: A news app lets users send an opt-out notice to independent advertising partners. The app supplies the switch; the partners must decide whether to stop profiling users. Which interpretation preserves the roles?
o: The app alone decides whether all advertisers stop profiling.
The app offers the setting, while the advertising partners handle requests.
The users created the advertising partners' software.
The advertising partners are the only parties who can send opt-out notices.

exp.trans: 新闻应用提供开关，用户借此发出退出通知，而收到通知的广告合作方需要决定如何响应。
exp.structure: 第一句说明app提供的渠道与用户动作，第二句分别用The app和the partners指明执行开关与处理请求的主体。
exp.other: opt-out notice退出通知；profiling用户画像；independent独立的；advertising partner广告合作方。
exp.meaning: 将创建界面、发送用户偏好和执行请求分开，不能将相关业务主体一概等同为同一家公司。
exp.rest: 只由应用负责所有广告商的行动与原文partners decide相反；用户和广告方软件开发、唯一发送者均未得到原文支持。
